purpose: Claim registry for the 2026-09-18 live-data audit (issue #3602): every public customer-facing claim raised by that audit maps to a verifiable live source — a shipped test, a code path, or a recorded D1 baseline — and to the copy rule that keeps the sentence inside the data. No claim may be added to this registry without a source entry that actually runs. Sentence-level auditing for the whole site lives in the sibling BET 10 registries (docs/customer-claim-table.json and docs/customer-claim-surface-registry.json, run mechanically by `npm run verify:claims`); this file is the live-data layer for the drifts that audit surfaced. tests/claim-registry.test.ts fails when a source stops existing or when public copy drifts from its claim's copy rule.

claims.sentence: …each confirmed change saved with page text, the source link, and a screenshot when the capture includes one, then summarized in the brief.
claims.surface: app/routes/marketing.tsx hero deck and FAQ, app/routes/competitor-monitoring.tsx, homepage proof-brief trail note

source.assert: AUDIT-SAVES-SCREENSHOTS row: screenshot copy is qualified to captures that include one; the site never promises a screenshot on every capture

liveBasis.measure: share of successful proof_capture rows carrying a screenshot_artifact_key

claims.copyRule: Every screenshot mention is qualified as 'a screenshot when the capture includes one'. While coverage is partial (19% at the 2026-09-18 audit), no public sentence may claim screenshots unconditionally.

app/routes/marketing.tsx: screenshot when the capture includes one
app/routes/competitor-monitoring.tsx: screenshot when the capture includes one

claims.sentence: Landing-page change history on tracked brands with a baseline.

source.assert: AUDIT-LANDING-PAGE-CHANGE-HISTORY: pricing feature string is scoped to brands with a baseline — no 'with screenshots' promise and no 'as scheduled watches complete' promise

liveBasis.measure: landing_page_snapshot row count and website_watch_target row count (no tracked brand carries a baseline yet; growth tracked in issue #2021)

claims.copyRule: Landing-page change history is advertised only as 'on tracked brands with a baseline'. While the baseline is empty, no public sentence may promise change history for a brand that has no baseline, and the pricing bullet stays scope-qualified.

app/lib/pricing.ts: Landing-page change history on tracked brands with a baseline

claims.sentence: No account needed. Preview one competitor now.
claims.surface: app/routes/marketing.tsx hero honest note and final CTA; empty state on /search

source.assert: labels public search as a coverage-qualified preview before account

liveBasis.measure: free preview outcome across recognised brands on 0509.io (2026-09-18 live test, issue #3602 §1.8)
liveBasis.measured: 3 of 6 recognised brands (allbirds, notion, oura) returned 'No verified ads found' after a 16-25s wait

claims.copyRule: The preview claim is coverage-qualified: the preview always runs, but the empty state honestly says 'No verified ads found for <domain>' and copy never promises verified ads for every brand. The hero keeps 'No account needed.' only while the preview runs without an account.

claims.sentence: Brand pages state stored ads as 'on record', with ads active at the last check shown separately.
claims.surface: app/routes/ads.$domain.tsx headline, count panels, and structured data

source.assert: issue #3593: the H1 states stored ads 'on record' in both states, and tests/ads-brand-page.structured-data.test.ts asserts structured data describes stored ads as on record, never running

liveBasis.measure: stored creative rows for nike.com vs ads active at the last check
liveBasis.measured: nike.com ads page 2026-09-18 showed 14 ads on record but only 5 active at the last check

claims.copyRule: Stored counts are phrased 'on record', never presented as currently running; the active-at-the-last-check count gets its own labeled panel copy. The home proof brief and the brand page report the same total for the same day (AUDIT-HOME-BRANDPAGE-COUNT-PARITY).
